infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SpeakBetter uses the microphone so you can speak in voice rooms and calls, and check your pronunciation.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SpeakBetter uses the camera when you choose to take a photo to send in a chat.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SpeakBetter opens your photos when you choose one to send in a chat or use as your profile picture.
